synthetic_lo_3000pkts.note: SO_BINDTODEVICE(lo)+IP_MULTICAST_IF(127.0.0.1); delta is BELOW the matched idle rate

interpretation: 19588 multicast RTP packets were emitted; the enp7s0 window that contains them is below both bracketing idle windows (9914 vs 12322/11003 packets and 7.28 vs 9.31/9.39 MB). If the stream had egressed, +19588 packets / +4.0 MB would appear. The local copy is still delivered to sockets joined on ANY interface of this host (loopback of the lo-bound send), which is why an enp7s0-joined receiver sees the stream with the host's own LAN address as peer.
